title: Routing Recommendation
description: An advisory recommendation from Seldon to Demerzel regarding task routing.

issue_or_pr.description: The identifier of the issue or pull request (e.g., 'ga#123').

required_capability.description: The primary capability required for the task.

recommended_worker.description: The identifier of the recommended worker (agent persona or human).

backup_workers.description: Alternative workers if the recommended one is unavailable or rejected.

confidence.description: Seldon's confidence in this recommendation based on historical data.

rationale.description: Detailed explanation for why this worker was recommended.

cost_notes.description: Estimated cost or efficiency considerations for this recommendation.

risk_notes.description: Identified risks (e.g., worker's low reliability in this domain).

human_review_required.description: Whether Seldon advises that the output of this task MUST be reviewed by a human.
